entities.summary: Maria Selena Nurcahya, known as Maria Selena, is an Indonesian actress and beauty pageant titleholder who was crowned Puteri Indonesia 2011 and represented her country at the Miss Universe 2012 pageant. She represented Central Java in the Pemilihan Puteri Indonesia 2011.
